description: TD-265 safely removes the two empty, non-addressable notification schema tables and their notification-only validator vocabulary after read-only local persistence evidence proves zero documents in both tables.
deviation_notes: Classic specification selected because this is a bounded schema-deletion chore. The repository is configured only for the anonymous local Convex deployment. No remote data or deployment mutation is inferred or authorized; a future remote deployment must run its own zero-row preflight before applying this schema commit.
